reference.code: import java.util.*;public final class Solution{public static String clampedSlice(String t,int s,int e){int[]r=t.codePoints().toArray();int n=r.length;if(s<0)s+=n;if(e<0)e+=n;s=Math.max(0,Math.min(n,s));e=Math.max(0,Math.min(n,e));return s<=e?new String(r,s,e-s):"";}}
